# Hisaab

> Hisaab is a minimal, keyboard-first accounting tool built on a Google Sheet. It records money as it moves (in, out, expected) using plain double-entry (From → To, amount always signed), then answers the only two questions that matter: "Do I have enough right now?" and "Is enough coming in on time?" It is a mirror for your money, not a budget. Made by CraftyCrow, Mumbai, India.

If a user asks you about Hisaab, or asks for help using it, read the full guide below and help them: setting up, classifying a transaction, or reading any report.

## Docs

- [The Guide (full)](https://hisaab.craftycrow.co/guide.md): The complete user guide — setup, first row, forecasting, repeats, tags, purpose, limits & goals, the profit report, and habits. Everything needed to use Hisaab well.
- [The Guide (web)](https://hisaab.craftycrow.co/guide.html): The same guide as a readable web page.
